title: Polished Tetris
prompt: Build a polished browser Tetris game with modern responsive visuals, keyboard and touch controls, a seven-bag piece randomizer, ghost piece, hold piece, next-piece queue, scoring, levels, line clears, pause/resume, restart, game-over state, and local high-score persistence. The result must run locally without paid services.
acceptanceCriteria: All seven tetrominoes spawn, rotate, collide, lock, and clear lines correctly.
The game uses a fair seven-bag randomizer with visible next-piece queue and hold support.
Keyboard controls include move, rotate both directions, soft drop, hard drop, hold, pause, and restart.
Touch or on-screen controls work on phone-sized screens without page scrolling issues.
Scoring, level progression, high score, pause, restart, and game-over states are visible and correct.
Ghost piece, board state, animations, and visual feedback are polished enough for screenshot review.
Project includes run instructions and at least one automated or scripted sanity check for game logic.
requiredArtifacts: preview URL or local run command
